audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[0..6] all read 'Hwei' and the packet levelChart is also 'Hwei' for all 7 stages.
audit.why: Hwei out-ranges Braum's short-range kit at every stage - his Q is a slow short-range poke, his engage requires Stand Behind Me/Unbreakable setup that costs lane presence, and he offers peel rather than kill pressure. Content's whys[] already grounds this and matches the packet.
audit.corrected: Flip all 7 phases[N].side to 'Hwei' and rewrite each why to state the stage-specific range/setup-cost reason from content.

audit.why: Spikes correctly track level 2 range advantage, level 6 ult zoning his engage angle, first-item poke vs. Concussive Blows setup, and late two-item burst outclassing his peel kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states that Unbreakable (E) blocks and negates the first projectile from a direction, or gives Concussive Blows' real stack mechanic (spread damage across sources to avoid feeding 4 stacks).
audit.why: Both are matchup-defining: eating a poke into his raised shield wastes the cast outright, and stacking Concussive Blows on one target hands Braum a free stun.
audit.corrected: Folded the shield-block mechanic and stack-spreading advice into dontsFull and the cooldowns rewrite.
